meta.name: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
meta.description: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

videos.title: First Space Colony Visit
videos.overview: Satou Takahiro awakens to find himself in a universe identical to his favorite sci-fi game.

videos.title: Mimi the Girl
videos.overview: After landing on the trade colony Tarmein Prime, Hiro rescues an orphan named Mimi.

videos.title: Elma
videos.overview: The space force demands that Elma pay for the damage she caused during the previous battle.

videos.title: A New Daily Life
videos.overview: Hiro's crew take a break to go shopping and acquire some critical data after defeating some suspicious ships.

videos.title: The Singing Crystal
videos.overview: Against a massive fleet, Hiro and his crew go on a reckless giant-killing mission.

videos.title: The Arein System
videos.overview: Hiro and his crew undergo a medical examination by Shouko, an inquisitive doctor.

videos.title: The Pirate-Hunting Unit
videos.overview: Just as Hiro's crew is about to leave on vacation, they receive a distress call from the local port authority.

videos.title: Sleeping Beauty
videos.overview: After a battle against space pirates, Hiro's crew recover a cold-sleep pod from the floating wreckage.
